title: Quiet Chapel
shortDescription: Rosemary and coloured light fill a small place for stillness.
longDescription:
Plain benches face a narrow window of green and honey-coloured glass. A sprig of rosemary rests on the sill, and the hush feels offered rather than demanded.
Near the floor, a smooth listening stone touches an exposed oak root. Three worn circles mark its surface. Here the low note beneath the school is almost clear enough to hum.

fixtures.name: Listening Stone
fixtures.examineDescription: You rest your palm on the cool stone and wait. Three low pulses travel through the oak root: one, a pause, then two together. The window gives no answering rattle. A carving says: 'The bell is gone. The welcome remains.' You have heard an echo in living wood, not footsteps or a creature below.
